name: Viper - Realism Compatibility Patch
teaser: This adds SPT Realism compatibility for stuff from the Viper mod.
description_html:
Contents

Compatibility patches for for stuff from the Viper mod.

If you experience any issues, feel free to open an issue. If fixing it yourself is more your thing, there’s a guide on how to contribute on the GitHub repository.

I plan on adding compats for more WTT Armory weapons along the road, feel free to suggest any that don’t have compats

Dependencies

You’ll need the weapon mod(s) that you need compatibility for**,** and SPT Realism for this to do anything.

Notes

1. For Realism versions prior to v1.4.5, the Viper will basically never malfunction. This is due to how malfunction calculations were changed in Realism v1.4.5.

Installation

1. Download the latest release.

2. Drop the provided user folder into your SPT folder.

If the changes don’t load, you may want to also clear cache / temp files.

3. In \user\cache, delete:

bundleHashCache.json, jsonCache.json, and modCache.json

But do NOT delete the folder named bundles.

4. In the SPT launcher, clear temp files:

Open launcher > Click settings > Click clean temp files
